source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: Which pair of metadata fields does SKILL.md require?

options.feedback: A name is required, but licensing information is optional. The required partner is the description.
These fields identify the skill and explain its intended use so it can be selected.
A description is required, while compatibility information is optional. The skill also needs a name.
These can supply useful extra information, but neither replaces the required name and description.
